name: Three Of A Crime
summary: Deduction game where detectives use overlap clues to identify three hidden guilty suspects.
rules_text: Shuffle suspect cards face down. Each round one player is the eyewitness and others are detectives. The eyewitness secretly draws the target card which shows three guilty suspects. In clockwise order detectives draw a card from the deck and place it face up. The eyewitness places a number token 0, 1 or 2 on that card equal to how many suspects on it also appear on the hidden target, without revealing which ones. After any clue any detective may interrupt to say Accusation and name three suspects. If correct, the eyewitness reveals and the accuser wins the target card; if wrong, that accuser is eliminated for the round. Play continues until someone is correct or all detectives are out, in which case the eyewitness wins the card. Shuffle unused cards. The next player becomes eyewitness. First to collect three cards wins.
rating_reason: Deduction game with hidden eyewitness card, logical strategic play.
